title_en: In or on: v or na
card_en: Rooms and closed spaces take v: v sobi, v omari. Surfaces and open places take na: na mizi, na balkonu, na vrtu. Learn each place with its word: in the garden is na vrtu.

quick_check.explain_en: A balcony is an open place, so it takes na: na balkonu.

helper_de: Often as in German: auf dem Balkon is na balkonu, in der Küche is v kuhinji. But im Garten is na vrtu.
helper_en: English says in the garden but on the balcony. Slovenian says na for both: na vrtu, na balkonu.
